```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE)
library(data.table)
library(oceancolouR)
library(raster)
library(ggplot2)
library(rasterVis)
library(patchwork)
library(dplyr)
library(ncdf4)
```

Collecting maps of input variables and the resulting PP maps using different models, for comparison:  


```{r, fig.height=10, fig.width=10}
xlims <- c(-95,-42)
ylims <- c(39,82)
canada <- map_data("world")

# get input and pp for bio_v1_carla
bio_v1_input <- dplyr::bind_cols(fread("model_comparisons/BIO_v1_Carla/201807_LHTBI.csv"),
                                 fread("model_comparisons/BIO_v1_Carla/201807_pi-20141113.csv"))
rast_alphab <- var_to_rast(bio_v1_input %>% dplyr::select(Name,alphaB), ext=c(xlims,ylims))
rast_pmb <- var_to_rast(bio_v1_input %>% dplyr::select(Name,PmB), ext=c(xlims,ylims))
rast_chl <- var_to_rast(bio_v1_input %>% dplyr::mutate(chl=log10(chlor_a)) %>% dplyr::select(Name,chl), ext=c(xlims,ylims))
pp <- dplyr::bind_cols(bio_v1_input %>% dplyr::select(Name),
                       fread("model_comparisons/BIO_v1_Carla/201807_pp.csv")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(cppday >= 0)
rast_pp <- var_to_rast(pp %>% dplyr::select(Name, cppday), ext=c(xlims,ylims))

# get vgpm pp
rast_vgpm <- raster("model_comparisons/VGPM/vgpm.2018182.hdf")
extent(rast_vgpm) <- extent(c(xmin=-180,xmax=180,ymin=-90,ymax=90))
rast_vgpm <- crop(rast_vgpm, extent(c(xlims,ylims)))
rast_vgpm[rast_vgpm < 0] <- NA

make_map <- function(rast,title,use_lims=TRUE) {
    cm <- colorRampPalette(c("#00007F","blue","#007FFF","cyan","#7FFF7F","yellow","#FF7F00","red","#7F0000"))(100)
    p <- rasterVis::gplot(rast) +
      geom_tile(aes(fill = value)) +
      geom_map(data = canada, map = canada, aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group, map_id=region), fill = "white", colour = "#7f7f7f", size=0.5) +
      scale_x_continuous(expand=c(0,0), limits=xlims) +
      scale_y_continuous(expand=c(0,0), limits=ylims) +
      coord_fixed(1.5) +
      theme_bw() +
      ggtitle(title) +
      theme(strip.background=element_blank(),
            strip.text=element_blank(),
            axis.title.x=element_blank(),
            axis.title.y=element_blank(),
            legend.title=element_blank(),
            legend.position="bottom",
            legend.direction="horizontal",
            legend.text=element_text(angle=45,hjust=1))
    if (use_lims) {
      rvals <- values(rast)
      rmedian <- median(rvals,na.rm=TRUE)
      rsd <- sd(rvals,na.rm=TRUE)
      rlims <- c(max(0,rmedian-3*rsd),rmedian+3*rsd)
      rast[rast<rlims[1]] <- rlims[1]
      rast[rast>rlims[2]] <- rlims[2]
      p <- p + scale_fill_gradientn(colours = cm, limits=rlims)
    } else {
      p <- p + scale_fill_gradientn(colours = cm)
    }
    return(p)
}

r1 <- make_map(rast_alphab, "alphaB - BIO_v1 (from Carla)",use_lims=FALSE)
r2 <- make_map(rast_pmb, "PmB - BIO_v1 (from Carla)",use_lims=FALSE)
r3 <- make_map(rast_chl, "log10(chl) - BIO_v1 (from Carla)",use_lims=FALSE)
r4 <- make_map(rast_pp, "Daily PP - BIO_v1 (from Carla)")
r5 <- make_map(rast_vgpm, "Daily PP - VGPM")

wrap_plots(list(r1,r2,r3,r4,r5),nrow=2,byrow=TRUE)

```
